## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

library("readxl")
library("tidyverse")
library("vegan")
library("viridis")
library("emmeans")
library("DescTools")
library("patchwork")
library("ggrepel")
```

```{r}
#| label: import-data

BFC_CORES  <- read_excel("BFC_lithic_data.xlsx", sheet = 1)
BFC_FLAKES <- read_excel("BFC_lithic_data.xlsx", sheet = 2)
BFC_TOOLS  <- read_excel("BFC_lithic_data.xlsx", sheet = 3)
BFC_CHUNKS <- read_excel("BFC_lithic_data.xlsx", sheet = 4)
```

```{r}
#| label: global-variables

core_order <- c("Initial_core", "Unifacial_core", "Bifacial_core",
                "Multifacial_core", "Centripetal_core", "Discoidal_core",
                "Bipolar_on_anvil_core", "Core_on_flake")

flake_order <- c("Cortical_flake", "Unipolar_flake", "Bipolar_flake", "Orthogonal_flake",
                 "Centripetal_flake", "Naturally_back_flake", "Debordant_flake", "Kombewa_flake",
                 "Ordinary_flake", "Bipolar_on_anvil_flake")

tool_order <- c("Scraper", "Notch", "Denticulate", "Chopper", "Informal_tool", "Hammerstone")

raw_material_order <- c("Mudstone", "Sandstone", "Silicalite", "Limestone",
                        "Trachyte", "Andesite", "Granite")

CORTEX_BREAKS <- c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)
CORTEX_LABELS <- c("0-20%", "20-40%", "40-60%", "60-80%", "80-100%")

backed_flake_types <- c("Debordant_flake", "Naturally_back_flake")
flake_type_levels  <- c("Cortical_flake", "Unipolar_flake", "Bipolar_flake", "Orthogonal_flake",
                        "Centripetal_flake", "Backed_flake", "Bipolar_on_anvil_flake")

categorize_cortex <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Cortex_category = cut(Cortex,
                                 breaks = CORTEX_BREAKS,
                                 labels = CORTEX_LABELS,
                                 include.lowest = TRUE,
                                 right = FALSE))
}

plot_theme <- theme(
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
  axis.line = element_blank(),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text()
)
```

## Overall Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
#| label: total-count

integration <- function(data) {
  data %>% select(Raw_material, Type) %>% drop_na()
}

total_count <- bind_rows(
  integration(BFC_CORES),
  integration(BFC_FLAKES),
  integration(BFC_TOOLS),
  integration(BFC_CHUNKS)
)

count(total_count)
table(total_count)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-raw-material
#| fig-cap: "Raw material counts"

total_count %>%
  count(Raw_material) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage   = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2),
    Raw_material = factor(Raw_material, levels = raw_material_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Raw_material, y = n, fill = Raw_material)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", begin = 0, end = 0.9) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-type-count
#| fig-cap: "Artifact type counts"

total_count %>%
  count(Type) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2), Type = fct_reorder(Type, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Type, y = n, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", begin = 0, end = 0.9) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Cores

### Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: core-summary

BFC_CORES %>%
  group_by(Techno_typology) %>%
  summarise(
    n             = n(),
    Length        = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Length, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Length, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Width         = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Width, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Width, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Thickness     = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Thickness, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Thickness, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Mass          = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Mass, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Mass, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Flaking_angle = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Flaking_angle, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Flaking_angle, na.rm = TRUE)),
    N_scar_total  = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(N_scar_total, na.rm = TRUE), sd(N_scar_total, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Techno_typology = factor(Techno_typology, levels = core_order)) %>%
  arrange(Techno_typology)
```

### Typology Count

```{r}
#| label: fig-core-typology
#| fig-cap: "Core typology counts"

BFC_CORES %>%
  count(Techno_typology) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage      = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2),
    Techno_typology = factor(Techno_typology, levels = core_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Techno_typology, y = n, fill = Techno_typology)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", begin = 0, end = 0.9) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Dimensions

```{r}
#| label: fig-core-dimensions
#| fig-cap: "Core dimensions by typology"

BFC_CORES %>%
  select(Techno_typology, Length, Width, Thickness) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Length, Width, Thickness), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "Value") %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    Dimension       = factor(Dimension, levels = c("Length", "Width", "Thickness")),
    Techno_typology = factor(Techno_typology, levels = core_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Dimension, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE), y = Value)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Dimension), width = 0.3, size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Techno_typology, scales = "fixed", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-core-angle-scar
#| fig-cap: "Core flaking angle and scar count by typology"

BFC_CORES %>%
  select(Techno_typology, Flaking_angle, N_scar_total) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(Techno_typology = factor(Techno_typology, levels = core_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Flaking_angle, N_scar_total), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Techno_typology, y = Value, color = Techno_typology)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
```

### Techno-organization

```{r}
#| label: fig-core-techno-org
#| fig-cap: "Core techno-organization by typology"

TO_order <- c(
  "Initial_exploitation", "Unifacial_unidirectional", "Unifacial_oppsite",
  "Unifacial_orthogonal", "Unifacial_semicentripetal", "Unifacial_centripetal",
  "Bifacial_unidirectional", "Bifacial_bidirection", "Bifacial_multidirection",
  "Bifacial_centripetal", "Multifacial_bidirection", "Multifacial_multidirection",

)

BFC_CORES %>%
  count(Techno_typology, Techno_organization) %>%
  group_by(Techno_typology) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2)) %>%

  mutate(
    Techno_typology     = factor(Techno_typology, levels = core_order),

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Flakes

### Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: flake-summary

BFC_FLAKES %>%
  filter(Type != "Incomplete_flake") %>%
  group_by(Techno_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n             = n(),
    Length        = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Length, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Length, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Width         = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Width, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Width, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Thickness     = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Thickness, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Thickness, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Mass          = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Mass, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Mass, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Butt_width    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Butt_width, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Butt_width, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Butt_depth    = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Butt_depth, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Butt_depth, na.rm = TRUE)),
    IPA           = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(IPA, na.rm = TRUE), sd(IPA, na.rm = TRUE)),
    N_dorsal_scar = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(N_dorsal_scar, na.rm = TRUE), sd(N_dorsal_scar, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Techno_type = factor(Techno_type, levels = flake_order)) %>%
  arrange(Techno_type)
```

### Dimensions

```{r}
#| label: fig-flake-dimensions
#| fig-cap: "Flake dimensions by typology"

BFC_FLAKES %>%
  select(Techno_type, Length, Width, Thickness) %>%
  filter(!Techno_type %in% c("Kombewa_flake", "Ordinary_flake")) %>%
  mutate(Techno_type = if_else(Techno_type %in% backed_flake_types, "Backed_flake", Techno_type)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Length, Width, Thickness), names_to = "Dimension", values_to = "Value") %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    Dimension   = factor(Dimension, levels = c("Length", "Width", "Thickness")),
    Techno_type = factor(Techno_type, levels = flake_type_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(Dimension, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE), y = Value)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Dimension), width = 0.3, size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Techno_type, scales = "fixed", ncol = 7) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
```

### Zingg Classification

```{r}
#| label: fig-flake-zingg
#| fig-cap: "Zingg classification of complete flakes"

flake_clean <- BFC_FLAKES %>%
  filter(Type == "Complete_flake", !Techno_type %in% c("Kombewa_flake", "Ordinary_flake")) %>%
  mutate(
    Techno_type = if_else(Techno_type %in% backed_flake_types, "Backed_flake", Techno_type),
    Techno_type = factor(Techno_type, levels = flake_type_levels)
  )

hull_data <- flake_clean %>%
  group_by(Techno_type) %>%
  slice(chull(Fineness, Elongation)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(flake_clean, aes(x = Fineness, y = Elongation, color = Techno_type)) +
  geom_polygon(data = hull_data, aes(fill = Techno_type, group = Techno_type),
               alpha = 0.15, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Techno_type), color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 21, stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.66, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.66, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.1, NA), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.4, NA), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "D") +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "D") +
  labs(x = "Fineness (Thickness / Width)", y = "Elongation (Width / Length)", color = "Techno_type") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"))
```

### Platform Size

```{r}
#| label: fig-platform-size
#| fig-cap: "Platform width vs. depth by flake type"

flake_filtered <- flake_clean %>% filter(Techno_type != "Bipolar_on_anvil_flake")

ggplot(flake_filtered, aes(x = Butt_width, y = Butt_depth, color = Techno_type)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Techno_type), color = "black", size = 2.5, shape = 21, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), breaks = seq(0, 80, by = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 5)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(x = "Platform width (mm)", y = "Platform depth (mm)", color = "Techno_type") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Techno_type)
```

```{r}
#| label: platform-lm

model <- lm(Butt_depth ~ Butt_width * Techno_type, data = flake_filtered)
summary(model)
emtrends(model, pairwise ~ Techno_type, var = "Butt_width")
```

## Tools

### Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: tool-summary

BFC_TOOLS %>%
  group_by(Tool_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Length           = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Length, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Length, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Width            = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Width, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Width, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Thickness        = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Thickness, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Thickness, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Mass             = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Mass, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Mass, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Ave_S_layer      = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Ave_S_layer, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Ave_S_layer, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Edge_angle_Total = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(Edge_angle_Total, na.rm = TRUE), sd(Edge_angle_Total, na.rm = TRUE)),
    GIUR_Total       = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(GIUR_Total, na.rm = TRUE), sd(GIUR_Total, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(Tool_type = factor(Tool_type, levels = tool_order)) %>%
  arrange(Tool_type)
```

### Flake Blank Tools

```{r}
#| label: flake-blank-tools

flake_tools <- BFC_TOOLS %>% filter(Type == "Tool", Blank == "Flake")

flake_tools %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(c(Length, Width, Thickness), list(
      mean = ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      sd   = ~ round(sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    ), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")
  )

flake_tools %>% count(Retouch_direction_1, sort = TRUE)
flake_tools %>% count(Retouch_location_1, sort = TRUE)
```

### Tool vs. Complete Flake Size Comparison

```{r}
#| label: tool-flake-permanova

combined_data <- bind_rows(
  flake_tools %>% select(Length, Width, Thickness) %>% mutate(Group = "Tool"),
  BFC_FLAKES %>% filter(Type == "Complete_flake") %>% select(Length, Width, Thickness) %>% mutate(Group = "Complete_flake")
)

distance_matrix <- dist(combined_data %>% select(Length, Width, Thickness), method = "euclidean")
group_factor    <- factor(combined_data$Group)

permutest(betadisper(distance_matrix, group_factor), permutations = 9999)

adonis2(
  formula = combined_data %>% select(Length, Width, Thickness) ~ group_factor,
  method = "euclidean", permutations = 9999
)
```

### PCA

```{r}
#| label: pca-function

run_lithic_pca <- function(data, vars, title_label, remove_outliers = TRUE) {
  pca_data <- data %>% select(Layer, all_of(vars)) %>% na.omit()

  if (remove_outliers) {
    for (v in vars) {
      Q1      <- quantile(pca_data[[v]], 0.25)
      Q3      <- quantile(pca_data[[v]], 0.75)
      IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
      pca_data <- pca_data %>%
        filter(.data[[v]] >= Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val, .data[[v]] <= Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val)
    }
  }

  res.pca  <- prcomp(pca_data[, -1], scale. = TRUE)
  var_exp  <- summary(res.pca)$importance[2, 1:2]

  scores       <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x)
  scores$Layer <- factor(pca_data$Layer)

  loadings         <- as.data.frame(res.pca$rotation)
  loadings$varname <- rownames(loadings)
  loadings$PC1     <- loadings$PC1 * 3
  loadings$PC2     <- loadings$PC2 * 3

  p_biplot <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Layer), geom = "polygon", type = "norm",
                 level = 0.75, alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Layer), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "white", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_segment(data = loadings, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
                 color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(data = loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = varname),
                    size = 3.5, fontface = "bold.italic",
                    box.padding = 0.5, segment.color = "grey50") +
    labs(
      title = title_label,
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2] * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#2A4858", "#F19C79", "#94B598")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#2A4858", "#F19C79", "#94B598")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid        = element_blank(),
      panel.border      = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
      plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position   = "right",
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )

  return(list(res = res.pca, biplot = p_biplot))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-pca-cores
#| fig-cap: "PCA biplot — Cores"

pca_cores <- run_lithic_pca(
  BFC_CORES_filtered,
  c("Length", "Width", "Thickness", "Mass", "Flaking_angle", "N_scar_total"),
  "Cores"
)
print(pca_cores$biplot)
```

### PCA-based PERMANOVA

```{r}
#| label: pca-permanova-function

run_pca_permanova <- function(data, vars, title_label, n_pc = NULL, remove_outliers = TRUE) {
  cat("\n==============================================\n")
  cat("--- PCA-based PERMANOVA:", title_label, "---")
  cat("\n==============================================\n")

  clean_data <- data %>% select(Layer, all_of(vars)) %>% na.omit()

  if (remove_outliers) {
    for (v in vars) {
      Q1      <- quantile(clean_data[[v]], 0.25)
      Q3      <- quantile(clean_data[[v]], 0.75)
      IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
      clean_data <- clean_data %>%
        filter(.data[[v]] >= Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val, .data[[v]] <= Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val)
    }
  }

  res_pca   <- prcomp(clean_data[, -1], scale. = TRUE)
  pc_scores <- if (is.null(n_pc)) res_pca$x else res_pca$x[, 1:n_pc]

  dist_matrix <- vegdist(pc_scores, method = "euclidean")
  meta_data   <- clean_data$Layer

  set.seed(1999)
  perm_res <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ meta_data, permutations = 9999)
  cat("[1] PERMANOVA on PC Scores:\n"); print(perm_res)

  disp_res    <- betadisper(dist_matrix, meta_data)
  perm_disp_p <- permutest(disp_res, permutations = 9999)
  cat("\n[2] PERMDISP on PC Scores:\n"); print(perm_disp_p)

  return(list(pca = res_pca, permanova = perm_res, permdisp = disp_res, clean_data = clean_data))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: pca-permanova-cores

run_pca_permanova(
  BFC_CORES_filtered,
  c("Length", "Width", "Thickness", "Flaking_angle", "N_scar_total"),
  "Cores", n_pc = 3
)
```

```{r}
#| label: pca-permanova-flakes

run_pca_permanova(
  BFC_FLAKES_filtered,
  c("Length", "Width", "Thickness", "Elongation", "IPA", "N_dorsal_scar", "Butt_width", "Butt_depth"),
  "Flakes", n_pc = 3
)
```
